source_text: Filiae Salphaad accipiunt inter fratres — hereditas feminarum in Israel. Animae fructus etiam in fragilibus.
pass_a_gloss: Daughters of-Zelophehad receive among brothers — inheritance of-women in Israel. Of-souls fruit even in fragile-ones.
pass_b_english: [[Zelophehad’s daughters receive among the brothers >> Bible:Joshua 17:3-6]]. Even fragile souls bear inheritance fruit.
